issues.legal_issue: A tenant should be granted leave to defend an eviction suit when the landlord relies on bona fide personal requirement and the tenant disputes that ground.
material_facts: The landlords sought eviction on the ground of bona fide personal requirement.
The tenant disputed that ground but was refused leave to defend the eviction suit.
issues.conclusion: The tenant should have been granted leave to defend and an opportunity to contest the suit; the refusal was set aside.
issues.legal_principle: The court held that leave to defend should be granted in these circumstances. The judgment cites no statutory provisions or earlier cases in support of this ruling.

predicates.eviction_suit_leave_to_defend: A tenant is seeking leave to defend a suit brought by a landlord for eviction.
predicates.landlord_claims_personal_requirement: The landlord seeks eviction on the ground of a bona fide personal requirement.
predicates.tenant_disputes_requirement: The tenant disputes the landlord's claim of bona fide personal requirement.

issues.definition: When a tenant seeking leave to defend an eviction suit faces a claim based on personal requirement that the tenant disputes, leave to defend is granted.
